notes.title: 1.5.10 Update
notes.content:
[b][h3]Changes[/h3][/b]
- Challenge mode (no cheats allowed)
- Challenges in hub menu
- Small captured asteroid in near Earth orbit
- Rocks on the surface of planets
- Round nosecone parts (added to parts expansion
- Worlds reordering fix
- other 1.5.10 changes

- New texture packs format + auto-upgrade for old
- WebImage component for mods gui
- UITools now is included into game by default
- Fixed mods broken loading for some people
